knowledge_gaps: The gBCE objective is unspecified: reproduce its calibration equation, positive/negative weighting, sampling-rate definition and numerically stable implementation. Excluding each user's training positives changes the sampling distribution and requires checking compatibility with the published calibration.

A five-item attention mask does not guarantee a five-item receptive field across multiple transformer layers. Define whether the recent branch uses independently truncated prefixes or sliding attention, and specify positional indices, padding masks and training/inference equivalence.

The four-way ablation lacks a GPU-time allocation, checkpoint-selection schedule and runtime estimate for two encoder passes with 128 negatives. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category can overfit the fixed validation sample.

Training-pair margins do not establish stale-context errors or expected HR@10 gains. Raw margins also depend on score scale, so comparing them across losses requires controlled diagnostic sampling and careful interpretation.

Originality 4/10 is plausible, but potential 8/10 and difficulty 5/10 remain speculative without validation evidence and implementation profiling. Establish the gBCE-only result before prioritizing the combined architecture.
